title: Job run request
description: What an orchestrator hands to an executor: run this operator, with these parameters, on this revision of the model, in this environment, and deliver the result like so. Carries no secrets.

model.description: The exact revision to run against, so a result can be tied to what was specified when it was produced.

environment.description: A name from the deployment's environment registry (see operators/environments.example.yaml); it says which executor to use and which capabilities exist there.
